operations.why: Only this dump bounds a crafting-recipe ingredient's aux value to 0..32767, and client behaviour has not confirmed that the client rejects values outside it, so decoding does not reject them until it does.

evidence.summary: The bound has no corroborating source: the pinned Mojang docs give no range for this field, unlike the item-stack-request name descriptor, whose 0..32767 bound matches client behaviour and stays.
